title: 递归推理系统的状态表示与终止条件
summary: 本文提出用认知状态图表示递归推理中的演化状态，并定义“序间隙”作为终止判据。主要结果给出了线性化序间隙在不动点附近非退化的充要条件，为递归推理系统、代理循环、思维树、定理证明和持续学习等场景提供了理论分析框架。
summary_en: This paper proposes representing evolving reasoning states as epistemic state graphs and defines the order-gap as a stopping criterion. The main result gives a necessary and sufficient condition for the linearized order-gap to be non-degenerate near the fixed point, providing a theoretical framework for recursive reasoning systems, agent loops, tree-of-thought, theorem proving, and continual learning.
